title: mut.channel_plane_color_field
mutation_directive: Channel plane-based color-field art. Render the form as PLANES (translucent quads / sheets / volumetric layers), not points or lines. Use THREE.InstancedMesh of small PlaneGeometry instances, each oriented either billboarded-to-camera or aligned to a local normal field. Pick one artist as the aesthetic anchor: James Turrell — luminous color-field volumes you would stand inside (Aten Reign at the Guggenheim). Stratified horizontal bands of translucent color, smooth gradients between bands, soft cyan-magenta-amber transitions. The form should feel inhabitable.. Stay near monochrome or two-color (saturated, low value contrast). Use additive blending with low per-instance opacity (0.04-0.10) so OVERLAP IS THE COMPOSITION — the deeper the stack of overlapping planes, the brighter and more saturated the local color. The piece should feel like LIGHT, not particles — Turrell's 'we eat light, drink it through our skins.'
